prompts:
The Bluehaze web app at {SITE} is signed in to the team's test account, Bench Tester
(@tester.bluehaze.test). Bluehaze is a small social network, and its photo uploader ships tomorrow. Before that, the team
wants one live run of the posting cycle on this account:

1. A post with exactly the text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, carrying an image you make, `./cover.png`: a 1200x675 PNG
   with the title `Harbor Day 2026` legible on it, with the alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
2. Then that post deleted, and only that post.

Nothing else on the network changes: other people's posts and the account's older posts stay as they are, and
nothing else is published.
answers:
The posting cycle is complete and the browser tab is closed; here is the final report.

## Goal
Run one live posting cycle on the Bench Tester account: publish a post with exact text, a 1200x675 PNG `cover.png` titled "Harbor Day 2026" with the required alt text, then delete only that post.

## Action
1. Created `./cover.png` (1200x675 PNG, dark blue background, white "Harbor Day 2026" centered, legible) in the workspace.
2. Opened Bluehaze at http://127.0.0.1:61532, used the **New post** composer: filled the rich-text editor with exactly `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, uploaded `cover.png` via the Upload image control, and set alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.` via the Add alt text dialog.
3. Published; verified the post appeared on the profile with the correct text and image (alt text confirmed in the accessibility tree as `image "Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026."`).
4. Deleted only that post via its options menu → Delete post → confirmed in the "Delete this post?" dialog.
5. Closed the browser tab I opened.

## Result
- Post published with exact text, correct image and alt text — verified live before deletion.
- Post deleted; the feed returned to its original state: Otto Fenwick (Oct 27), Mara Quill (Oct 26 reply), Mara Quill (Oct 25), Otto Fenwick (Oct 24), Bench Tester "Hello from the Bluehaze test account" (Oct 23), Mara Quill (Oct 22), Otto Fenwick (Oct 21) — all unchanged, nothing else published.
- `cover.png` (1200x675) remains in the workspace as the image artifact.
- Browser tab closed; no other tabs/windows/apps left open.

## Assumptions
- "Image you make, `./cover.png`" = I generate the PNG locally and upload it; the app's uploader accepts it (it does: accept includes image/png).
- "That post deleted, and only that post" = delete the one I just published, leaving all pre-existing posts (including the account's older "Hello from the Bluehaze test account" post) untouched.
- The compose dialog's single file input served the upload; the alt text is stored per-image in the app.

## How I know it is right
- Post text matched the brief byte-for-byte in the editor value and on the rendered post.
- The published post's image showed "Harbor Day 2026" legibly (screenshot) and its accessible name was exactly `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
- After deletion, the profile feed snapshot matched the pre-post state post-for-post (same authors, dates, texts, reply counts), confirming only the new post was removed.
